title: LineageBundle.v1
description: The complete lineage for ONE derived artifact: every link it needs to answer the promotability test — which raw + source artifacts (and their exact source handles) back it, which transform runs created it, which receipts warrant it, what was held out / rejected on the way, which prior versions it superseded, and where rollback points. Built by LineageBundle.build(store, artifact_id). A promotable served artifact MUST reach at least one source artifact id (check enforces). tenant_private lineage never enters a global_public bundle.

artifact_id.description: the derived artifact this bundle traces

raw_artifact_ids.description: raw layer ids reached by walking parents to the root

source_artifact_ids.description: source layer ids; a promotable served artifact must reach >=1

source_handles.description: exact ctx://... source handles backing this artifact; no empty handle on a promotable artifact

parent_artifact_ids.description: immediate parents (one hop up the derivation chain)

transform_run_ids.description: DistillationRun ids that produced this artifact and its ancestors

receipts.description: receipt ids proving each transform was warranted/safe

held_out_artifact_ids.description: items held out anywhere along the lineage; rehydratable, not erased

rejected_candidate_ids.description: losing candidates along the lineage; the winner keeps lineage to the losers

prior_version_ids.description: versions superseded by the current one; superseded never deleted

rollback_target_ids.description: the version(s) the active pointer can revert to

complete.description: true when every required link resolved with no empty/dangling handle
